title: Evidence-Grounded Creative Director and Composable Semantic Motion
problem: V3-52 renders a fixed 4-stage attention template; V3-51 can vary layouts without true causal motion. Allow an authoring plan to choose optional narrative beats, semantic action composition, visual staging and object emphasis without authoring Python.
research_hypothesis: One finite compositional compiler with a host-grounded QKV ledger and typed actions can render 3 materially different native attention stories from independently authored plan JSON, rather than dispatch by fixture name.
scope: OFFLINE_HOST_SYNTHETIC_ONLY; 0 provider calls; no retry of V3-50 single-use request; fixed teaching family two-token scaled dot product attention.

constraints: all host-derived facts have same SHA256
all reused visual IDs have stable meaning; no model Python
no unrelated numeric labels or user-authored equations
typed_stage_grammar.beat_duration_source: native WAV-exact voice durations, not estimated words

acceptance.frozen_tests: V3-50,51,52 and V2 core plus V3 benchmark protocol

audit: Physical decoded frames at stage boundaries and per-ratio causal colors; inspect actual MP4 not only CI receipt
